item.description:
Currently Reading

I get excited about a lot of books - am often juggling a few.

  • The Music Mind by Karl Berger (music)
  • Thinking with Type by Ellen Lupton (design)
  • Loving Kindness by Sharon Salzberg (life)
  • Seeing that Frees by Rob Burbea (life)
  • No Bad Parts by Richard C Schwartz (life)
  • Don’t Make Me Think by Steve Krug (design)

Anti-Library

What’s an anti-library?
I like thinking about an anti-library as “tsundoku” (積ん読) - the phenomenon of acquiring reading materials but letting them pile up in one’s home without reading them. The term is also used to refer to unread books on a bookshelf meant for reading later. (wikipedia)
  • A Pattern Language - Christopher Alexander
